findings.message: The margins differ: 124px on the left, 149px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Chaque pièce de votre image" (screen 5, 25% hidden); "Comment on travaille" (screen 8, 25% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 3 screens in a row: "[Nom du client]"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: Little motion: 14 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Give every section an entrance for its parts (not one fade of the whole block) and add one moving picture: a looping clip or a slow move on a photograph.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 360px: "Votre marque, on la construit. Votre marque, on " → 4 lines (10 words, 56px); "Un projet en tête ? On en parle. Un projet en tê" → 3 lines (16 words, 40px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: No visible button in the first phone screen.
findings.fix: On a phone the first screen still holds the headline, the supporting sentence and the action; move navigation into one row or a menu so it does not push them down.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 8px from the left edge but only to 31px from the right, at 360px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).
